review.summary: Single-hunk fix in gammalogpdf that avoids an Inf - Inf indeterminate form when x/θ is infinite. Previously `xlogy(k - 1, xθ) - xθ` evaluated to NaN for x = Inf (or θ → 0 with large x); the patch only adds the xlogy term when xθ is finite, so the result correctly tends to -Inf. This is a numerical correctness bug in an existing exported function, not a new capability.
review.evidence: Minimized production patch touches only src/distrs/gamma.jl, one hunk, reported globally minimal with all hunks necessary. The accompanying comment states the mathematical rationale (xlogy(k-1, xθ) - xθ → -∞ as xθ → ∞). Test change is confined to test/rmath.jl, the file comparing StatsFuns output against Rmath reference values, consistent with a value-correctness regression test. Runtime evidence reports a stable_differential across 3 repetitions with a dedicated trigger script, and the full suite passing on the fixed revision.

Type stability of the branch (val accumulated conditionally) should be confirmed for promoted mixed-precision inputs.
review.suggested_tests: Assert gammalogpdf(k, θ, Inf) == -Inf for several k (k < 1, k == 1, k > 1) and θ values, including k == 1 where the xlogy coefficient is zero. Check gammalogpdf(k, 0.0, x) and very small θ with large x for -Inf rather than NaN. Confirm gammalogpdf(k, θ, -Inf) and negative x still return -Inf. Verify no NaN appears for finite inputs by spot-checking against Rmath dgamma with log=true. Add a type-stability check (@inferred) for Float32 and Float64 argument combinations.
